title: An honor-system newspaper
hook: Two stated cases: explore quantity and payment receipts in a toy revenue example.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How quantity and payment receipts in a toy revenue example affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Profit, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare quantity and payment receipts in a toy revenue example in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy sale has 100 units at price 1, unit cost 0.4 and fraction 0 of revenue donated. What profit remains?
